intro: Start with Quick setup and Privacy. Viewer Spotlight stays disabled until you accept the public-display disclosure.

sections.title: 1. Quick setup
sections.description: Enable the add-on and match the self-request command.

sections.title: 2. Privacy approval
sections.description: Choose whether the selected local statistics may appear publicly.
sections.notice: Viewer cards never include raw account IDs, linked-account records, chat text, private messages, money, or provider payloads.

sections.title: 3. Twitch reward requests
sections.description: Use one Streamer.bot-owned reward and refund requests that cannot enter the bounded queue.
sections.notice: Reward requests are Twitch-only. The Settle Reward action must remain triggerless and creator-approved.

sections.title: 4. Optional Discord snapshot
sections.description: Keep the webhook secret in Streamer.bot, never in this settings page.

sections.title: 3. Public card fields
sections.description: Only enabled fields are rendered; unsupported values disappear instead of showing invented zeroes.
sections.notice: Engagement score uses only creator-weighted, capped sessions, messages, and commands. Exact monthly rank stays hidden until the Community Analytics minimum cohort is reached.

sections.title: 4. Requests and spam protection
sections.description: Bound the queue, expiry, per-viewer repeats, and total cards per stream.

sections.title: 5. Appearance
sections.description: Choose a fixed, fading, or upward credits-style card while retaining crop-safe text clamps.
